intent.objective.armyFellNoneQueued: The observed army count fell and no military reinforcements are queued. Recruit replacements if affordable; protect mining and military production while rebuilding.
intent.objective.armyFellQueued: The observed army count fell. Reinforcements are already queued: maintain mining and let production advance; regroup surviving combat units.
intent.objective.lowCreditsGatherOffered: Production is stalled with almost no credits. Check harvesters and restore ore collection using Support/gather ore. More tank orders cannot fund existing orders. Keep the refinery and miners.
intent.objective.lowCreditsMinersWorking: Production has almost no credits, but observed miners already have Gather/Dock orders. Let them finish the mining loop; avoid replacing these orders. Keep the useful queue short and funded.
intent.objective.lowCreditsNoGather: Production is stalled with almost no credits. Restore an income source using offered normal-view choices. More tank orders cannot fund existing orders.
intent.objective.restoreMining: Restore recurring income now: select Support, then gather ore with idle or diverted harvesters. Move and Force-move do not collect ore and replace mining orders. Leave Gather/Dock orders running long enough to return ore to a refinery.
intent.rules: Operating loop: mine ore, unload at refinery, fund production, replenish combat losses, then scout and attack with military units. Keep miners on Gather/Dock; do not spam movement or Stop on them. Keep a small military queue funded; a long queue is not an army. Ready buildings need Place; paused useful queues need Resume. Wait is useful while mining, construction or battle orders progress. Add power only for demand, expand income before funds run out, and preserve the base.
